'''Tralllnt''' was an intelligence veteran who worked under [[Scrivinir]] [[Sris Lehhett]] when the former [[Fleet Admiral/Legends|Fleet Admiral]] controlled the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. Tralllnt used [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]]-style intimidation tactics to aid Lehhett in controlling the region.<ref name="Centrality" />
